# PII Guard

> PII Guard is an open-source privacy firewall and OpenAI-compatible gateway for AI agents. It detects personal data in text and images, replaces it with reversible placeholders before a request reaches the model, and restores the real values in the response. Hungarian first, other EU languages next. Licensed under Apache-2.0.

This site (`https://guard.watt-mind.com/`) is the hosted preview: an interactive public walkthrough on synthetic data, and Google sign-in for testing with your own text and provider keys. All public examples on this site are fictional. Pseudonymization is not anonymization, and PII Guard does not by itself make a deployment GDPR or EU AI Act compliant.

## Key Capabilities

- **Bidirectional pseudonymization**: Replace sensitive entities with consistent, reversible placeholders (`POST /v1/mask` / `POST /v1/pseudonymize`) and restore original values in model outputs (`POST /v1/unmask` / `POST /v1/depseudonymize`).
- **OpenAI-compatible privacy proxy**: Drop-in gateway for `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/responses`, and `POST /v1/messages` with streaming support and session-scoped vaults.
- **Policy enforcement**: Per-entity and per-project actions (`pseudonymize`, `redact`, `allow`, `block`) across 62 PII entity types in 7 categories.
- **Hybrid local detection**: Deterministic checksum-aware regex and lexicon rules combined with local ONNX / DeBERTa-v3 and XLM-RoBERTa NER models, plus on-device OCR and face/signature image masking (`POST /v1/mask/image`), with sub-15ms p50 CPU latency on rules + fast paths.

## Public Pages

- [PII Guard Hosted Preview](https://guard.watt-mind.com/): Interactive walkthrough of bidirectional pseudonymization, image masking, and live agent replay
- [Interactive Demo](https://guard.watt-mind.com/#demo): Worked text and image masking examples on synthetic Hungarian and English inputs
- [Data & Privacy Boundary](https://guard.watt-mind.com/#trust): What the hosted preview processes, retention limits, and trust boundaries
- [Technical Architecture](https://guard.watt-mind.com/#technical): Hybrid detection pipeline, Meta model integration, and European language support
- [Benchmark Evaluation](https://guard.watt-mind.com/#evaluation): Interactive recall, precision, F1, and leak-rate charts across datasets and models
- [OpenAPI Reference](https://guard.watt-mind.com/#api): Full HTTP contract for the gateway, vault, and masking endpoints
- [Pricing & Quotas](https://guard.watt-mind.com/pricing): Hosted preview allowances, bring-your-own-key (BYOK) usage, and self-hosting options
- [Security](https://guard.watt-mind.com/security): Security architecture, isolation guarantees, and vulnerability reporting
- [Privacy Notice](https://guard.watt-mind.com/privacy): Data processing, ephemeral in-memory state, and cookie policy
- [Terms of Service](https://guard.watt-mind.com/terms): Acceptable use and hosted preview terms
- [Imprint](https://guard.watt-mind.com/imprint): Operator and project contact information

## Documentation

- [Source Code & Quick Start](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard): Self-host PII Guard, the web console, and the reversible vault via Docker or Python
- [Hosted Processing & Retention](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/hosted.md): What the hosted preview processes, where, and for how long
- [Privacy Model](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/privacy-model.md): Threat model, trust boundaries, and what PII Guard protects against
- [API Contracts](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/contracts.md): Detailed request/response schemas and session semantics
- [EU Regulation Context](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/eu-regulation.md): GDPR and EU AI Act considerations for pseudonymization gateways

## API Endpoints

- [OpenAPI Specification](https://guard.watt-mind.com/#api): Interactive API reference for `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/responses`, `POST /v1/messages`, `POST /v1/analyze`, `POST /v1/mask` (`POST /v1/pseudonymize`), `POST /v1/unmask` (`POST /v1/depseudonymize`), `POST /v1/mask/image`, and `GET /healthz`

## Models & Benchmarks

- [Benchmarks Documentation](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/benchmarks.md): Methodology, datasets, recall, and leak-rate evaluations on synthetic data
- [Agent Harness Matrix](https://github.com/watt-mind/pii-guard/blob/develop/docs/integrations/harness-matrix-2026-10-29.md): Compatibility and round-trip verification across AI coding harnesses
- [NER Model on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/watt-mind/pii-guard-ner-xlmr-base): Open multilingual token-classification checkpoint (`watt-mind/pii-guard-ner-xlmr-base`)
